Rumors of Apple partnering with LG to co-develop and launch new Home accessories, including security cameras and video doorbells, have been circulating, and recently leaked images may have already given us a first glimpse of these products.

Video doorbells and security cameras make an appearance, as Apple and LG collaboration product images are revealed

On the eve of next week's highly anticipated launch of three brand-new Apple Home products, Mark Gurman reported yesterday that Apple still has several home accessories co-developed with LG set to hit the market.

This new lineup of accessories includes a smart door lock, a thermostat, a video doorbell, an indoor camera, an outdoor camera, a floodlight camera, and a temperature sensor.

Earlier, leaker pdfu revealed images and details of the smart door lock, thermostat, and temperature sensor.

Now it seems product images focused on cameras have also surfaced, coming from X user @ringo_tech.

Although the account has a modest following, its track record of publishing information about smart home accessories has been solid and its credibility is reliable. It also posted a series of detailed product specifications, which look quite convincing. For example, in this post, the account disclosed the following:

Outdoor Camera (Plug-in Version) (link)

This news echoes earlier reports that LG TVs were storing transcripts of recordings or conversations and transmitting the data back to LG.

Indoor Camera (Plug-in Version) (link)

More product photos can be viewed through the posts linked above.

According to Mark Gurman's report, Apple and LG collaborated on the design and development of these products, which form part of their upcoming smart home overhaul, but the accessories will ultimately be brought to market under the LG brand name.

Would you consider picking up these rumored video doorbell and camera products? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
